items.name: Port Solana.app (Electron 45.2.1 pinned) packaged to .app and .dmg, unsigned
Production build served from local files over app://game (assets, GLBs, tiles, workers, WASM)
Performance switches: high-performance GPU, no throttling, 8 GB heap flag, WebGPU, GPU blocklist off, ANGLE Metal
Native fullscreen (F11, Cmd+Ctrl+F), pointer lock, large window, minimal menu, locked-down process
Crash guard: auto reload on renderer/GPU crash or hang, notice, crash.log in userData
Saves persist in the app (localStorage and IndexedDB under userData)
npm run desktop:build and desktop:dev; copy to ~/Desktop
5-minute fps (avg, 1% low) and memory: app vs headless Chrome
